capabilities: Transcribe YouTube video subtitles into a Markdown note
Render an interactive mindmap from iris-mindmap code blocks
Generate a summary and structured mindmap via an OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint
Build a degraded-mode mindmap from speech pauses without an LLM
Write frontmatter metadata indexable by Dataview
extras: Manual installation only; not yet in the community plugin marketplace. Without an LLM key it still works in degraded mode (paragraph transcript, pause-based mindmap).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a YouTube video's subtitles into a structured, indexable note with a summary and mindmap.

relations.evidence: YouTube — récupération des sous-titres de la vidéo demandée (via youtube-transcript-plus)
markmap-lib et markmap-view — transformation et rendu de la mindmap
Métadonnées en frontmatter, indexables par Dataview

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint (Fantasy Cloud, Groq, Google AI Studio, OpenRouter)
free LLM provider account for summary and structured mindmap

summary: YouTube-to-note tool that transcribes a video's subtitles into a Markdown note with an interactive mindmap and an optional LLM summary.
